dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12
WORKDIR /testbed

# Configure apt reliability for eval image builds
RUN printf '%s\n' 'Acquire::Retries "5";' 'Acquire::http::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::https::Timeout "120";' 'Acquire::http::Pipeline-Depth "0";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99jayint-retries

# Install git for cloning
RUN command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update && apt-get install -y git)

# Dependency-manager helpers inferred from verified setup
# No extra dependency bootstrap needed

# Clone repository and checkout base commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/rayai-labs/agentic-ray /testbed
# No base commit provided; using repository default branch HEAD

# Agent's verified setup instructions
RUN JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=1; JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS=3; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=1; while [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -le "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; do PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 /bin/sh -lc 'pip install uv' && JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=0 && break; JAYINT_PIP_STATUS=$?; (python -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || python3 -m pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip cache purge >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); if [ "$JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT" -eq "$JAYINT_PIP_MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"; fi; JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT=$((JAYINT_PIP_ATTEMPT + 1)); sleep 5; done; exit "$JAYINT_PIP_STATUS"
RUN uv sync

# Post-setup compatibility helpers inferred from verified setup
# No post-setup compatibility helpers needed
eval_script:
#!/bin/bash

cd /testbed


cd /testbed

set +e
(
cd /testbed/packages/python-sdk && uv run pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings
) && \
(
cd /testbed/tests/sdk-e2e-py && uv run pytest --collect-only -q --disable-warnings
)
TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
set -e

echo "echo OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$TEST_EXIT_CODE"
exit $TEST_EXIT_CODE

excluded_commands.command: which uv && uv --version (rejected before execution, combined probe)
which uv && uv --version && which python3 && python3 --version (rejected before execution)
cat .python-version && cat pyproject.toml && cat packages/python-sdk/pyproject.toml && cat tests/sdk-e2e-py/pyproject.toml && which uv (read-only inspection)
uv --version (read-only verification, not needed for build)
ls -d tests/*/ && ls -d guides/*/*/python/ && ls -d recipes/*/*/python/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---" ; find . -name "test_*.py" -o -name "*_test.py" 2>/dev/null | head -40 (read-only inspection)

build_recipe.rationale: The successful setup trajectory had two persistent state-changing commands: pip install uv (to install the uv dependency manager) and uv sync (to create the virtual environment and install all project dependencies). These are necessary and sufficient to make the final verified test commands work. All other commands were read-only inspections, verification probes, or test collection runs.
